title: Encouragement of Aliyah and Return (Temporary Provision) Law, 5786-2026
title_he: חוק עידוד עלייה לישראל וחזרה אליה (הוראת שעה), התשפ״ו–2026
source_id: Enacted by chapter D, section 9 of the Economic Efficiency Law (Legislative Amendments for Achieving the Budget Targets for Budget Year 2026), 5786-2026, ס״ח התשפ״ו 3511 (31 March 2026), pp. 416-418

official_pdf.pages_used: PDF pp. 4-6 (Sefer HaChukim pp. 416-418); the Law is chapter D, from the heading 'פרק ד׳' on PDF p. 4 to the heading 'פרק ה׳' on PDF p. 6
official_pdf.fetched_from: https://web.archive.org/web/20260718005658id_/https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_12235101.pdf (Internet Archive capture of the Knesset's own PDF)

files.what: The text of chapter D (ss 8 and 9, the Law's ss 1-6, and footnotes 5-9), TRANSCRIBED BY READING THE PAGE IMAGES of PDF pp. 4-6 (rendered with pdftoppm at 110 dpi and read), one printed clause per line, Hebrew in logical order, gershayim and geresh as ״ and ׳, superscript footnote marks omitted. The encoding's `src:N` comments quote line N of this file.
files.why_a_transcription: pdftotext reads the Hebrew words in logical order but scrambles digits, hyphens and the parentheses around numerals (bidi reordering): '(1)' comes out as '( )1', '2026 ותושב' as '2026ותושב', 'התשי״ב-1952' as 'התשי״ב1952-'. A quotation of that extraction would misprint every paragraph number.
files.checked_by: encodings/legalese-2026-10-il-36/tools/transcheck.py: the multiset of Hebrew words and of digit runs of the transcription equals that of the PDF's own text layer for the chapter D region (it does not check order); and by reading all three pages against the transcription (NOTES.md section 0)

files.what: The raw output of `pdftotext -layout -f 4 -l 6` (poppler 25.12.0) on the PDF above, kept as the provenance of the transcription. Bidi control characters are left in; the garbling described above is in it.

text_status: The Law as enacted, as first published (Sefer HaChukim 3511, 31 March 2026). No amendment of the Law is in the sources. Hebrew is authoritative; the transcription is a working text checked against the PDF, not an official copy.
